name: red_flags
description: Low-back red flags knowledge graph for DigiMSK triage (screening, discrimination, disposition)

nodes.label: Factor
nodes.role: Symptoms, traits, and mediating clinical concepts. path mediators share this label.

nodes.label: Condition
nodes.role: Red-flag diagnoses (Fracture, Malignancy, Infection, CES, AAA, DVT)

nodes.label: Chunk
nodes.role: Evidence text and metadata; loc stored as property only (not a graph node)

relationships.when: path_type is mediated or both, and path is not empty
path_type is mediated or both, and path is not empty

constraints: CREATE CONSTRAINT factor_name IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Factor) REQUIRE n.name IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT condition_name IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Condition) REQUIRE n.name IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT chunk_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Chunk) REQUIRE n.chunk_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE INDEX chunk_specific IF NOT EXISTS FOR (c:Chunk) ON (c.is_specific)
excluded_from_graph: BodyLocation nodes (loc is Chunk property only)
